analysis: The code snippet uses a StringTokenizer to iterate over tokens of `classPath` with delimiter `pathSep`. The while loop condition `st.hasMoreTokens()` ensures that `nextToken()` is only called when there are more tokens. Therefore, the `NoSuchElementException` thrown by `nextToken()` when no tokens remain is fully avoided by this guard.
remark: The NoSuchElementException would be triggered if `nextToken()` is called when the StringTokenizer has no more tokens. However, the while loop checks `hasMoreTokens()` before each call, so this condition never occurs.
